subject.title: feat: bound raw transcript reads across replacements

question: Should OpenClaw accept schema v12 with durable transcript-generation rows and publish `readSessionTranscriptRawDelta` as a supported Plugin SDK contract?
rationale: The code is a bounded implementation, but it creates both a persistent upgrade commitment and a new external API; repository policy reserves SQLite schema advances and SDK-contract direction for explicit maintainer acceptance.

options.title: Approve the foundation contract
options.body: Accept schema v12 and the documented generation-aware cursor API, then require current-main upgrade and SDK compatibility proof before merge.

options.title: Keep the optimization internal
options.body: Retain only an owner-scoped active-memory optimization and remove the public SDK export plus durable cursor contract.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Pause this PR until a maintainer-sponsored transcript pagination and Plugin SDK direction is recorded.

recommendation.title: Approve the foundation contract
recommendation.body: Accept schema v12 and the documented generation-aware cursor API, then require current-main upgrade and SDK compatibility proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only concrete implementation contact identified in the supplied history and can incorporate the chosen scope, while a core maintainer must make the final contract decision.
